show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/m3B6Ls
show.description: Sneha, a kind-hearted woman, lives peacefully until her brother’s accident leaves him needing ₹80 lakhs for surgery. Desperate, she meets Vikram Devraj, a ruthless mafia boss with a hidden past. He offers her a deal- marry him for a year in exchange for the money. Reluctantly, she agrees, but their cold contract turns into something deeper. When her ex-lover returns and Vikram’s enemies strike, Sneha’s world spirals into chaos ending in a shocking gunshot that changes everything.
